CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageEnabled.Name: Enable Damage Advantage
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageEnabled.Hint: Master switch. Turn this off to stop the module touching any roll, including per-character effects. Leave it on and use the switch below for normal play.
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageGlobal.Name: Apply to Every Actor
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageGlobal.Hint: While on, every actor in the world - player characters, NPCs and monsters alike - rolls the damage types below twice and keeps the higher total. No effect needs adding to anyone. Also toggleable from the skull button in the token controls.
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageTypes.Name: Damage Types
CGM.Settings.DamageAdvantageTypes.Hint: Which damage types get the doubled roll. Separate several with commas, e.g. necrotic,radiant. Any dnd5e damage type key.
CGM.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug Logging
CGM.Settings.Debug.Hint: Log each roll this module modifies to the console for troubleshooting.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.AnnounceOnDetail: Every actor now rolls {types} damage twice and keeps the higher total.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.AnnounceMasterOff: The module's master switch is off, so nothing will actually change until it is turned back on in Module Settings.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.GMOnly: Only a GM can change the world-wide damage advantage switch.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.Error: {module} failed to apply damage advantage to this roll. The roll itself is unaffected. See the console for details.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.NoActor: Select a token or pass an actor to toggle damage advantage.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.NotOwner: You do not have permission to change effects on {name}.
CGM.DamageAdvantage.NoType: No damage type given, and no damage types are configured.
